menu.title: Mega Feast Duo Combo
menu.desc: Combo includes: 1x Deal 1: Solo Crunch Fiesta. Special limited-time deal price!

menu.title: Deal 1: Solo Crunch Fiesta
menu.desc: 1 Crunch Zinger Burger + 1 Regular Salted Fries + 1 Chilled Fountain Soda.

menu.title: Deal 2: Duo Pizza & Wings Feast
menu.desc: 1 Regular Pizza (Any Flavor) + 1 Crispy Zinger Wrap + 6 pcs BBQ Wings + 2 Chilled Drinks.

menu.title: Deal 3: Family Mega Party Combo
menu.desc: 1 Large Pizza + 2 Crunch Zinger Burgers + 1 Loaded Curly Fries + 1.5L Chilled Coke Bottle.

menu.title: Classic Pepperoni Feast
menu.desc: Zesty tomato pomodoro sauce, double beef pepperoni slices, Italian herbs, loaded with 100% pure melted mozzarella cheese.

menu.title: Creamy Chicken Tikka Supreme
menu.desc: Smoked chicken tikka chunks, sweet bell peppers, red onion rings, fresh mushrooms, topped with creamy garlic ranch swirl.

menu.title: Fajita Sicilian Flame
menu.desc: Spicy Mexican fajita chicken, fiery jalapenos, sweet corn, black olives, finished with crushed chili flakes and cheddar blend.

menu.title: Smoky BBQ Ranch Chicken
menu.desc: Hickory smoked grilled chicken tenders, caramelized onions, crispy bacon bits, Texas BBQ drizzle, and provolone-mozzarella blend.

menu.title: Cheesy Margherita Gold
menu.desc: San Marzano crushed tomato sauce, fragrant fresh sweet basil, virgin olive oil drizzle, and golden melted whole milk mozzarella.

menu.title: Crunch Zinger Crispy Burger
menu.desc: Hand-breaded extra crispy chicken fillet dipped in secret spicy batter, iceberg lettuce, and spicy chipotle mayo on toasted brioche.

menu.title: Double Smash Cheddar Beef Burger
menu.desc: Two 100% prime beef patties smashed sizzling hot on the flat-top, double American cheese, dill pickles, secret shack relish.

menu.title: Loaded BBQ Mushroom Melt
menu.desc: Charbroiled Angus patty smothered with sautéed button mushrooms, melted Swiss cheese, caramelized onions, and smoky hickory sauce.

menu.title: Club Supreme Triple Decker Sandwich
menu.desc: Three layers of toasted buttered bread packed with sliced grilled chicken breast, fluffy egg omelet, cheddar cheese, crisp iceberg, and tomato slices.

menu.title: Grilled Philly Cheese Steak Sandwich
menu.desc: Tender sliced sirloin beef tossed on the grill with sautéed sweet onions, green bell peppers, and molten provolone cheese inside an artisan hoagie roll.

menu.title: BBQ Smoked Pulled Chicken Panini
menu.desc: Slow-cooked pulled chicken breast bathed in rich BBQ sauce, pressed crisp in sourdough ciabatta with gooey melted mozzarella and red onion relish.

menu.title: Crispy Zinger Tortilla Wrap
menu.desc: Golden crispy fried chicken strips rolled in warm toasted flour tortilla with diced tomato, fresh romaine lettuce, and signature garlic mayonnaise.

menu.title: Spicy Peri Peri Grilled Chicken Wrap
menu.desc: Flame-grilled chicken breast basted in Portuguese peri-peri marinade, sweet corn, red onion, baby greens, and tangy peri mayo.

menu.title: Smoky Mexican Beef Burrito Wrap
menu.desc: Seasoned lean ground beef, refried pinto beans, Mexican salsa, sweet corn, cheddar cheese, and fresh coriander wrapped tight and lightly toasted.

menu.title: Chilled Mint Margarita Fizz
menu.desc: Blended fresh mint leaves, lime juice, black salt, and sparkling citrus soda served over crushed crystal ice.

menu.title: Classic Cold Brew Iced Frappe
menu.desc: Rich Arabica espresso blended with cold creamy milk, caramel drizzle, and topped with chocolate curls.

menu.title: Thick Belgian Oreo Shake
menu.desc: Decadent milkshake blended with premium vanilla bean dairy ice cream, whole Oreo biscuits, and rich chocolate fudge.

menu.title: Chilled Fountain Soda (Coke / Sprite)
menu.desc: Ice cold carbonated soda served with crushed ice and fresh lemon slice.

menu.title: Warm Sizzling Molten Lava Cake
menu.desc: Rich dark chocolate cake with a molten flowing fudge center, served piping hot with a scoop of French vanilla ice cream.

menu.title: New York Baked Strawberry Cheesecake
menu.desc: Classic dense and velvety cream cheese filling on a buttery graham cracker crust, topped with fresh glazed wild strawberries.

menu.title: Crispy Cinnamon Churros with Nutella Dip
menu.desc: Golden fried Spanish dough pastry tossed in fragrant cinnamon sugar, served with a pot of warm silky Nutella.

menu.title: Lotus Biscoff Sundae Tower
menu.desc: Layers of creamy soft-serve vanilla ice cream, caramelized Lotus Biscoff spread, crunchy crushed speculoos biscuits, and waffle crisp.

menu.title: Classic Belgian Chocolate Waffle
menu.desc: Freshly ironed crisp Belgian waffle smothered with warm melted milk chocolate, powdered sugar, and dark chocolate chips.
